items.context: Are you facing an issue with the payment on delivery?
items.text: payment failed

items.context: Was the cash amount ready at the time of delivery?
items.text: cash nahi tha

items.context: Did you receive any confirmation after paying cash?
items.text: nahi mila payment confirmation
mera name Ramesh Singh aur address Noida hai payment cash on delivery tha lekin delivery boy nahi aaya
maine kal Mumbai mein order diya tha aur payment cash on delivery tha lekin abhi tak confirm nahi hua
delivery boy ne cash maangha tha lekin mere paas cash nahi tha to ab payment kaise hoga
main Neha Rajput hn Hyderabad ki aur mera order payment door pe hi karna tha par payment reject ho gaya
mera order Bangalore mein tha aur payment cod pe tha lekin payment process nahi ho raha hai aap help karo
payment reject ka message aaya aur delivery boy bhi refund nahi kar raha address Gurgaon hai mera
order cash on delivery tha lekin payment receipt nahi aayi mujhe Mumbai ke address par delivery hui thi

items.context: Can you tell me why the payment on delivery did not go through?
items.text: mere pas cash nahi tha isliye payment failed hua

items.context: Was there any issue with the cash amount when delivery was attempted?
items.text: delivery boy ne paise accept nahi kiye kyunki exact amount nahi tha

items.context: Where are you calling from and what happened with the cash on delivery payment?
items.text: mai sohna hu Ludhiana ka aur paisa lekar nahi aaya delivery boy

items.context: Did you try to pay cash at the time of delivery?
items.text: main payment karna chahti thi par delivery boy cash lene se mana kar diya

items.context: Do you know why the cash on delivery payment got cancelled?
items.text: payment cancel hone ki wajah kya hai humne cash ready rakha tha
mera naam Ankit Gupta hai aur maine last week Delhi se ek product order kiya tha jo cash on delivery tha par payment nahi hua
maine payal kumari ke naam se order diya tha aur address Patna tha lekin payment process nahi hua cash on delivery ke liye
main Arjun Singh hu Lucknow se aur mujhe delivery par paise dene the par delivery boy ne kaha payment cancel ho gaya hai toh ab kya karun

items.context: Could you please explain what problem you are facing with cash on delivery payment?
items.text: maine suna ki payment ka issue aa raha hai kya aap mujhe bata sakte hain ki merese kya problem hui

items.context: Can you confirm if the delivery boy mentioned any reason for the payment failure?
items.text: delivery boy ne kaha payment nahi hua par mere paas cash tha main Rohit Kumar Chennai se bol raha hu

items.context: Were you able to give cash to the delivery boy when your order was delivered?
items.text: main Priya Sharma Gurgaon se hu aur mera order cash on delivery tha lekin delivery boy payment lene se mana kar raha hai

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: delivery
Intent: cod_payment - has a problem with cash on delivery or payment at the door
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
